senses.sense_definition: A large crater formed by the collapse of a volcano's cone or edifice.

examples.text: The massive <w>caldera</w> was created after the volcano erupted and its peak collapsed inward.
Many beautiful lakes are found inside an ancient <w>caldera</w> formed thousands of years ago.

senses.sense_definition: A city, port, and commune in Copiapó province, Atacama region, northern Chile.

examples.text: The port of <w>Caldera</w> is a major hub for shipping in northern Chile.
Many tourists visit <w>Caldera</w> to enjoy the nearby beaches and coastal scenery.

senses.sense_definition: A corregimiento in Boquete district, Chiriquí province, Panama.

examples.text: The small town of <w>Caldera</w> is located in the Chiriquí province of Panama.
Travelers often pass through <w>Caldera</w> while exploring the mountainous regions of Boquete.
